system.description:
Readied Baggage (Passive): All Readied baggage items must be equipped to RIS to work. When occupying RIS, baggage items create extra RIS within them, often with specific requirements.

Vial (Small) (Passive): This item provides 3 readied item slots (RIS). You may only put items with the Small Property into these RIS. All items placed in the vial’s slots must be the same.

1 Item Slot · 20gc · Readied Baggage, rulebook p.202
